spots.name: Triumphal Arch, Chișinău
spots.summary: The Triumphal Arch is a monument situated in Central Chișinău next to the Nativity Cathedral on Piața Marii Adunări Naționale nr. 2 and directly opposite Government House.

spots.name: Nativity Cathedral, Chișinău

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Cathedral of Christ's Nativity is the main cathedral of the Moldovan Orthodox Church in Sectorul Centru, Moldova. It was built in 1830 to a design by Abram Melnikov.

spots.name: Chișinău Water Tower

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Chișinău Water Tower is an architectural monument of Chișinău, Moldova, located at 2 Mitropolit Bănulescu-Bodoni Street and built at the end of 19th century after a project by Alexander Bernadazzi. It was a main part of Chișinău's water system. The upper level was built of wood and was destroyed by an earthquake.

spots.name: National Museum of Fine Arts

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The National Museum of Fine Arts of Moldova is a museum in Chișinău, Moldova, founded in November 1939 by Alexandru Plămădeală and Auguste Baillayre.
spots.wikipediaTitle: National Museum of Fine Arts, Chișinău

spots.name: Chișinău Central Cemetery
spots.summary: The Chișinău Central Cemetery is a cemetery located in the Sectorul Centru of Chișinău, Moldova, in the "triangle" of Alexei Mateevici, Vasile Alecsandri and Pantelimon Halippa. Founded in 1811, it is the resting place of many prominent personalities in the history and culture of Moldova.

spots.name: St. Teodora de la Sihla Church

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The St. Teodora de la Sihla Church is a cathedral in Central Chișinău, Moldova. It functions as the cathedral of the Metropolis of Bessarabia.
spots.wikipediaTitle: St. Teodora de la Sihla Church

spots.name: Chișinău City Hall
spots.summary: Chișinău City Hall is a historical and architectural monument built in Italian Gothic style located in Central Chișinău, Moldova. Originally constructed to house the city Duma in 1901, the building was nearly destroyed during World War II.

spots.name: National History Museum of Moldova

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The National History Museum of Moldova is a museum in Central Chişinău, Moldova.

spots.name: Eternity Memorial Complex, Chișinău
spots.summary: The Eternity Memorial Complex is a memorial located in Chișinău, the capital of Moldova. The memorial is located along P. Halippa Street. It is dedicated to Soviet soldiers who died in the Second Jassy–Kishinev Offensive.

spots.name: Capitoline Wolf, Chișinău
spots.summary: The Capitoline Wolf is a monument in Central Chișinău, Moldova. It is located in front of the National History Museum of Moldova.

spots.summary: House-Museum of Alexandr Pushkin is a museum and architectural monument in Moldova of national value. It is included in the Register of monuments of history and culture of the municipality of Chișinău.

spots.name: Alley of Classics
spots.summary: The Alley of Classics is a sculptural complex located in the Stephen the Great Park in Central Chișinău, Moldova.

spots.summary: Ciuflea Monastery is a Moldovan Orthodox monastery located in Chișinău, Moldova. It is dedicated to Saint Theodore of Amasea.

spots.name: National Library of Moldova

hours.note: Closed Fri

spots.summary: The National Library of Moldova located in Chișinău, Moldova is the main library of the state, which is responsible for conservation, valorization and protection of written cultural heritage.

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Wooden church of the Dormition of Mary of Hirișeni is a religious building built in 1642. As of today, the church is preserved in the Village museum of Chișinău, Republic of Moldova.

spots.summary: The Transfiguration Church is a Moldovan Orthodox church located in Chișinău, Moldova.

spots.name: Memorial to Victims of Stalinist Repression
spots.summary: The Train of Pain – Memorial to Victims of Stalinist Repression is a monument in Chișinău, Moldova. A temporary stone was unveiled in 1990 in Central Station Square commemorating the 1940–1951 mass deportations in Soviet Moldavia. A permanent memorial was completed at the site in 2013.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Memorial to Victims of Stalinist Repression

spots.name: Sfatul Țării Palace
spots.summary: The Sfatul Țării Palace is a building in Chișinău, Moldova.

spots.name: Stephen the Great Central Park
spots.summary: The Stephen the Great Central Park is the main park in Central Chișinău, Moldova. It is the oldest park in Moldova and spans about 7 hectares. It has gained the nickname "The Park of the Lovers" in Chișinău due to its popularity as a meeting spot for couples.

spots.name: Maria Bieșu National Opera and Ballet Theatre
spots.summary: The Maria Bieșu National Opera and Ballet Theatre in Chişinău, Moldova, is one of the leading opera and ballet theatres in Eastern Europe. It is housed in a building on the Boulevard Stefan the Great, one of the main roads in Chişinău. In 2012, it was given the name of the renowned opera singer Maria Bieșu.
spots.wikipediaTitle: Maria Bieșu National Opera and Ballet Theatre

spots.name: Cathedral of Divine Providence, Chișinău

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Cathedral of Divine Providence is a religious building affiliated with the Catholic Church which is located in Chișinău, Moldova, and is the see of the Diocese of Chișinău.

spots.name: Mihai Eminescu National Theatre
spots.summary: The Mihai Eminescu National Theatre is a historical and architectural monument built in neoclassical style located in Central Chișinău, Republic of Moldova. Originally constructed to house various cultural activities in 1931, the purpose of the building and its name changed several times over the years.

spots.name: Muzeul Memoriei Neamului

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Muzeul Memoriei Neamului is a private museum in Chișinău, Moldova, dedicated to the victims of the Soviet Occupation of Bessarabia and Northern Bukovina, and commemorating anti-communist resistance in the region.

spots.name: Monument to the Victims of the Soviet Occupation
spots.summary: The Monument to the Victims of the Soviet Occupation is a proposed monument in Chișinău, Moldova.

spots.name: Palace of the Republic
spots.summary: The Palace of the Republic is an official multi-purpose building as well as a concert and theatre hall in Moldova. It is located at the Buiucani sector in the commune of Condrița in Chișinău.

spots.name: Jewish cemetery, Chișinău
spots.summary: The Chișinău Jewish Cemetery is a Jewish cemetery in the Sectorul Buiucani of Chișinău, Moldova. It is situated on Milano Street and spans approximately 100 hectares and contains over 20,000 graves dating back to the 17th century.

spots.name: National Museum of Romanian Literature

spots.summary: The National Museum of Romanian Literature is a museum in Chișinău, Moldova.

spots.name: Monument to Simion Murafa, Alexei Mateevici and Andrei Hodorogea
spots.summary: The Monument to Simion Murafa, Alexei Mateevici and Andrei Hodorogea was a monument in Central Chişinău, Moldova. It existed between 1933 and 1940.

spots.name: Army Museum of Chișinău
spots.summary: The Army Museum of Chișinău, is a center of military history of the Armed Forces of Moldova located in northern Chișinău, the capital of Moldova.

spots.name: Statue of Queen Maria
spots.summary: Marie was the last queen consort of Romania from 10 October 1914 to 20 July 1927 as the wife of King Ferdinand I.

spots.name: National Palace, Chișinău
spots.summary: The Nicolae Sulac National Palace in Chișinău. A 2,000-seat auditorium, it is the biggest hall in Moldova. It was constructed in 1972 and opened in 1974 to mark the 50th anniversary of the Moldavian Soviet Socialist Republic. It was originally named the Octombrie Concert Hall and the Session Hall before that.

spots.name: National Museum of Ethnography and Natural History

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The palaeontological part of the exhibition includes a skeleton of Deinotherium, a fearsome prehistoric relative of elephants. There is a good collection of traditional dresses, and a scale model of Moldova. Even if you don't enter the Islamic-inspired exterior facade is quite stunning, particularly late afternoon when it catches the sunshine.

spots.name: Dinamo Stadium
spots.summary: Stadionul Dinamo is a multi-use stadium in Chişinău, Moldova. It is currently used mostly for football matches and is the home ground of FC Politehnica Chişinău. The stadium holds 2,900 people.

Memorial Park
spots.summary: A little way out of the center is a memorial commemorating the victory of the Soviet army in World War II. There is also an eternal flame in memory of Chișinău's unknown soldiers who died in World War II. It is behind the military and civilian cemeteries. Reach by taking trolleybus 9 or 13 from Ismail Street.
